set -eu
umask 077
inventory_password=[REDACTED]]] -c 32 /dev/urandom | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')
[ "${#inventory_password}" -eq 64 ]
inventory_hash=$(printf '%s' "$inventory_password" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
env_tmp=$(mktemp /etc/redis-inventory.env.XXXXXX)
printf 'REDIS_HOST=%s\nREDIS_PORT=6379\nREDIS_USERNAME=inventory\nREDIS_PASSWORD=[REDACTED]]] "$NODE_IP" "$inventory_password" > "$env_tmp"
install -o root -g root -m 0600 "$env_tmp" /etc/redis-inventory.env
rm -f "$env_tmp"
acl_tmp=$(mktemp /etc/valkey/users.acl.XXXXXX)
printf 'user default off\nuser inventory on #%s ~inventory:* &inventory:* +@all\n' "$inventory_hash" > "$acl_tmp"
install -o root -g valkey -m 0640 "$acl_tmp" /etc/valkey/users.acl
rm -f "$acl_tmp"
unset inventory_password inventory_hash
stat -c '%n owner=%U group=%G mode=%a size=%s' /etc/redis-inventory.env /etc/valkey/users.acl
